title: Smart financial regulation: the balance between stability and growth
summary: The Spanish Institute of Financial Analysts (IEA) has published a report titled “How to improve European competitiveness, growth and innovation through the rationalization of banking regulation.” The regulatory complexity identified by Draghi and Letta as a constraint on Europe’s global competitiveness is creating frictions that limit the financial system’s ability to channel savings into productive investment. According to the report, it is urgent to move from political consensus on regulatory simplification to concrete reforms that explicitly integrate competitiveness and growth objectives into the European regulatory and supervisory framework, while preserving financial stability. The report provides practical recommendations to improve regulation, supervision, and the competitiveness of the European financial sector.
